district.name: Uttara Kannada
district.geographic_features: Characterized by dense evergreen Western Ghat forests, wide river estuaries (Sharavathi, Kali, Aghanashini), and majestic sea forts.
district.climate: Tropical monsoon with heavy rainfall and lush biodiversity.
district.image_alt: Laterite walls and grounds of Mirjan Fort in Uttara Kannada

records.title: Gokarna Mahabaleshwara Temple
records.description: Ancient 4th-century CE temple housing the revered Atmalinga, a prime destination for Shaivite pilgrimage and Sanskrit learning.

records.title: Murudeshwar Shiva Statue & Temple
records.description: Features the world's second-tallest Shiva statue overlooking the Arabian Sea, flanked by a towering 20-story Raja Gopura.

records.title: Mirjan Fort Spice Bastion
records.description: 16th-century laterite fort associated with the Queen of Gersoppa (Chennabhairadevi), historically noted for pepper and spice shipping.

places.name: Gokarna Beach & Mahabaleshwara
places.description: Sacred coastal town famous for pristine beaches (Kudle, Om, Paradise) and ancient Vedic traditions.

places.name: Murudeshwar Temple & Giant Shiva Statue
places.description: Monumental coastal temple complex built on Kanduka hill surrounded by the sea on three sides.

places.name: Yana Karst Rock Formations
places.description: Massive monolithic rock outcrops of solid black crystalline limestone nestled deep within evergreen Western Ghat forests.

media_references.title: Mirjan Fort Stone Walls and Moat
media_references.subject: Medieval defensive architecture
